notes: SIMDTEST / IMD launch on Ethereum mainnet (chainId 1). Hook constructor is (IPoolManager manager, IERC20 token): $poolManager resolves to 0x000000000004444c5dc75cB358380D2e3dE08A90 and $token to the SIMDTEST the factory deploys just before the hook. The hook needs no other address: IMD (0xd34a...63b7) and the SIMD Hackathon vault (0x3dd5f73dd1a4e62630fad3909673f130ad429985) are compile-time constants, and the hook creates its immutable SIMDTESTVault in its constructor (read it from hook.vault()). No owner, setter, proxy, delegatecall, selfdestruct or upgrade path; every parameter is a constant or immutable. SIMDTESTHook is deployed directly at a CREATE2 address carrying flag mask 0x20cc (8396): beforeInitialize | beforeSwap | afterSwap | beforeSwapReturnDelta | afterSwapReturnDelta, exactly what getHookPermissions returns; the constructor validates the mask. beforeInitialize accepts only the PoolManager as caller and only the pool key (sorted SIMDTEST/IMD, fee 12500, tickSpacing 60, this hook); it has no sender allowlist, so $factory is not a constructor argument. The LP fee is the static 12500 tier; the hook never uses the dynamic-fee flag, updateDynamicLPFee or an LP-fee override. Hook fees are taken on the IMD side only, never on SIMDTEST, through beforeSwap/afterSwap return deltas: anti-snipe 30% at the deployment block decaying by 3 percentage points per block to 0% from block +10, plus a permanent 1% staking fee, both on gross IMD. Fees are minted as ERC-6909 IMD claims to the hook, so no PoolManager balance is needed before router settlement and nothing is charged on token transfers to the PoolManager or on liquidity changes. The only swap the hook refuses is a specified amount whose gross-up overflows int256 (UnrepresentableFee). sweep() is permissionless: it burns the claims, takes anti-snipe fees to the hackathon vault and staking fees to the vault, then calls notifyReward with the IMD actually received. Vault: stake/unstake any time, reward-per-token accumulator in IMD, totalStaked/earned/pending views; rewards attach to stake that existed when fees accrued, and a stake earns only from the block after it is made, so same-block or in-unlock flash stakes earn nothing. Token: plain ERC-20, 1e27 units minted once to its deployer (the factory); the factory alone seeds the pool, pays the swarm allocation and remainderTo. The fee clock starts at hook construction, so the factory must deploy the hook and initialize the pool in the same transaction. initialPrice is provenance only; the factory sets the opening price. Offline checks: forge build, 79 tests passed and 2 fork tests skipped, and the protected hook/token floors pass with the creation code and mask above. Live mainnet-fork execution is still owed (no RPC here). See README.md and docs/review.md.
